name: Doll Replica Walk
description: Create a city-street moment where you walk beside a life-size doll replica of you in matching outfits, each holding a coffee cup. Just upload a photo and your video is ready to share.
prompt_template: Animate the uploaded person walking along a city street beside a realistic life-size doll replica of themselves. Both wear matching outfits and carry coffee cups. Natural camera tracking, believable steps, stable facial identity and coherent body motion; playful funny scene.

name: Real Mugshot
description: Step into the precinct with a gritty police booking mugshot. Features an official inmate placard with your name and height measurement background grid.
prompt_template: Edit the uploaded portrait into a believable funny police booking mugshot. Height chart background, police-station lighting and inmate placard, exaggerated surprised expression; preserve recognizable facial identity.

name: Toddler Tantrum
description: Hilarious baby crying transformation with an oversized animated baby head, playroom toys, and dramatic theatrical tantrum expressions.
prompt_template: Transform the uploaded person into a hilarious theatrical toddler tantrum portrait in a toy-filled playroom, with big expressive face, dramatic crying expression and playful surreal proportions. Keep key facial traits recognizable.

name: Morning Messy Doll
description: Wake up as a whimsical messy-haired doll sipping morning coffee in the kitchen. The perfect blend of morning chaos and cozy chic.
prompt_template: Create a photorealistic funny morning doll look of the uploaded person, untidy hair and sleepy expression, cozy kitchen, oversized mug of coffee. Preserve face identity and composition.

name: Object Overload
description: Turn your still frame into a playful editorial moment with one matching object drifting down into a dense pile. Completely surrounded by retro alarm clocks.
prompt_template: Animate a fun editorial shot centered on the uploaded person as retro alarm clocks slowly fall into a growing pile nearby. Subtle human motion, stable identity and consistent framing, smooth realistic movement and clean video.

name: Vintage Wanted Poster
description: Wild West wanted poster printed on aged crinkled parchment with 5 gold stars reward banner, vintage wood plank background, and Western saloon typography.
prompt_template: Create an old western wanted poster using the uploaded person’s recognizable face, weathered parchment, vintage serif lettering area, wooden saloon backdrop, sepia historical photography and funny serious pose.

name: Bobblehead Sam
description: Transform yourself into a real collectible spring-necked bobblehead toy standing on polished hardwood with miniature toy race cars and alphabet blocks.
prompt_template: Create a lifelike collectible bobblehead figure inspired by the uploaded person: oversized head, short spring neck, miniature base, toy cars and alphabet blocks on polished hardwood, recognizable face.

name: Comic Dork Duos
description: Go wild with expressive cartoon faces, silly tongue poses, and bursting comic book stickers, zap explosions, hearts, and pop art doodles.
prompt_template: Reimagine the uploaded person in an expressive comic-book portrait with goofy faces, silly tongue poses, comic starbursts and playful pop-art stickers while preserving recognizable facial features.

name: Emoji Explosion
description: Submerge your cheerful face into an ocean of hundreds of bright yellow smiley face emoji spheres. High energy positivity for social feeds.
prompt_template: Create a vivid humorous studio portrait of the uploaded person surrounded by hundreds of bright yellow smiley emoji balls, cheerful lively expression, realistic glossy spheres and clear face identity.

name: Head in Hands Gallery
description: A mind-bending museum optical illusion where you stand casually in a fine art gallery holding your own detached smiling head in your hands.
prompt_template: Create a tasteful surreal optical illusion in an art museum where the uploaded person stands while holding a realistic smiling replica head in their hands. Keep the person’s actual face recognizable.

name: Thanksgiving Doll Chef
description: A cozy doll host proudly showing off a massive golden-brown roasted Thanksgiving turkey in a vintage country kitchen.
prompt_template: Create a realistic whimsical doll-chef scene featuring the uploaded person in a vintage country kitchen proudly presenting an enormous golden roast turkey. Preserve facial identity and humorous proportions.

name: Supermarket Choice Cut
description: Surreal pop art transformation displaying your face vacuum-sealed in a supermarket butcher tray with cellophane wrap and grocery price sticker.
prompt_template: Create an imaginative surreal product photography scene: a stylized replica of the uploaded person’s face presented inside sealed supermarket-style clear tray packaging with a price sticker, no blood or injury. Preserve recognizability.

name: Too Good To Be Free
description: Hilarious glamorous mugshot holding an official booking placard: "POLICE DEPT. TOO GOOD TO BE FREE - 849173" against a height grid.
prompt_template: Create an amusing glamorous police mugshot of the uploaded person with a booking placard reading TOO GOOD TO BE FREE, height chart backdrop and polished fashion lighting. Preserve recognizable identity.

name: Bubble Balloon Gown
description: High fashion viral dress sculpted entirely out of glowing bubble balloons and clear sphere bubbles on a bold studio pink backdrop.
prompt_template: Create a high-fashion photorealistic portrait of the uploaded person wearing a gown sculpted from luminous translucent bubble balloons, vivid pink studio background, recognizable face and detailed lighting.

name: Cool Sunglasses Emoji Face
description: Street style effect holding an oversized glossy yellow sunglasses smiley emoji paddle mask right over your face.
prompt_template: Create a fun street-style image of the uploaded person holding a large glossy yellow sunglasses-smiley emoji paddle mask close to their face, natural hands, stylish streetwear and visible recognizable facial details.

name: Stealing The Show
description: Celebratory precinct mugshot with falling gold confetti, glitter outfit, and placard reading "POLICE - STEALING THE SHOW 73491".
prompt_template: Create a glam funny police booking portrait of the uploaded person with gold confetti falling, sparkly outfit, height chart and placard reading STEALING THE SHOW. Preserve facial identity.
